findings.evidence: Moebius.lean:296 `@[norm_cast] lemma coe_unitDiscMoebiusHomeomorph_apply`; Homeomorph.lean:89 `@[norm_cast] lemma coe_unitDiscStandardAutomorphismHomeomorph_apply`; new lemmas here are `@[simp]` only.
findings.fix: Add @[norm_cast] (keeping @[simp]) to these four coe_*_apply lemmas, matching coe_unitDiscMoebiusHomeomorph_apply and coe_unitDiscStandardAutomorphismHomeomorph_apply.
findings.issue: The coercion-of-application lemmas coe_unitDiscMoebiusClosedBallHomeomorph_apply (171), coe_unitDiscMoebiusSphereHomeomorph_apply (221), coe_unitDiscStandardAutomorphismClosedBallHomeomorph_apply (346) and coe_unitDiscStandardAutomorphismSphereHomeomorph_apply (407) are tagged @[simp] but not @[norm_cast], breaking the file family's convention.

findings.evidence: Lines 180/229 have no attribute; 367/426 are `@[simp]` only; no norm_cast path exists for the symm coercions.
findings.fix: Add @[norm_cast] to the four coe_*_symm_apply lemmas for cast-normalization parity with the coe_*_apply lemmas.
findings.issue: coe_unitDiscMoebiusClosedBallHomeomorph_symm_apply (180) and coe_unitDiscMoebiusSphereHomeomorph_symm_apply (229) carry no attribute, so norm_cast cannot rewrite `↑((...).symm w)` for these maps (the @[simp] `*_symm` lemma is not in the norm_cast set). The standard-automorphism symm_apply lemmas (367, 426) are @[simp] only, likewise lacking norm_cast.

summary: Bodies are hidden and the characteristic API (apply/symm_apply/symm/_one) of each bundled homeomorphism is complete, but the new coercion-of-application lemmas drop the @[norm_cast] tag that every analogous coe lemma in the open-disc files carries, so norm_cast/push_cast can no longer normalize coercions of these maps.
